newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996 overseas ship orders fall 5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996 overseas ship orders fall 5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipbuilders in 1996 totalled 234 vessels, or 7.7 million gross registered tons (grt), down five percent from the previous year, an industry body said on Thursday.
"Although ship orders decreased from 1995, we can still say orders of more than seven million grt are high," an official of the Japan Ship Exporters' Association said.
In 1995, overseas ship orders totalled 8.1 million grt.
Japanese shipbuilders have managed to maintain a competitive edge despite the yen's strength against the dollar over recent years by streamlining operations and cutting costs, the official said.

In December, ship export contracts totalled 19 vessels or 713,740 grt, down 10.7 percent from the same month a year earlier. The orders comprised one freighter, 16 bulk carriers and two tankers, the association said.
